mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_report_run ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, run_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, run_control_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, run_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, student_no VARCHAR(32), name_keyword VARCHAR(64), class_name VARCHAR(64), gender VARCHAR(16), min_age INT, max_age INT, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, deleted BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_student_report_run_run_id (run_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_student_report_run_owner_code (owner_id, run_control_code, deleted), KEY idx_student_report_run_owner_created_at (owner_id, created_at), KEY idx_student_report_run_owner_status_created_at (owner_id, status, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

UPDATE student_report_run SET run_control_code = #{runControlCode}, run_name = #{runName}, student_no = #{studentNo}, name_keyword = #{nameKeyword}, class_name = #{className}, gender = #{gender}, min_age = #{minAge}, max_age = #{maxAge}, status = #{status}, deleted = #{deleted}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE run_id = #{runId}
